# Forum debate: Darth Krayt vs Darth Sidious (Suspect Insight)

**URL:** https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t1921-darth-krayt-versus-darth-sidious
**Pages read:** 1 of 1 (19 real posts + 2 "Sponsored content" placeholders; checked `t1921p20-...`, `p25`, `p50`, which return an empty "Information" page, so there is no page 2). Fetched with curl 2026-10-10. Raw HTML: `forum-raw/t1921.html`.
**Dates:** 17-28 Dec 2019.

## Matchup and conditions (OP HellfireUnit)
- Sidious "prior to killing his master" (so pre-Plagueis-death, around TPM) vs Reborn Krayt.
- R1 sabers, R2 Force, R3 all-out, R4 teams: Sidious + Plagueis vs Krayt + Wyyrlok III + Darth Caedus.

## Arguments
**For Krayt:** almost nobody cites evidence. Posters just give verdicts: "Krayt sweeps all rounds" (Master Azronger), "krayt low key stomps imo" (lorenzo.r.2nd), "Krayt murks R1-3" (EmperorCaedus). BreakofDawn's R2 reason: Krayt is "Much more powerful and comparable mastery."
**For Sidious:** BreakofDawn gives Sidious R1 (sabers) only ("Sidious I guess").
**R4 side debate (Plagueis vs Caedus):**
- BreakofDawn (pro team 1): "Plagueis has both esoteric abilities on his side… I don't see Caedus doing much against a character approaching ROTS Sheev levels of power."
- NevesYtneves (DC77) rebuttal: "Jacen learned secrets that had been lost to the Jedi for centuries, and is repeatedly noted as having a hugely diverse skill set." Also: "Plagueis is a huge end of novel power up+a decade of constant growth away from Sidious lol, he's not close at all." And: "Sidious feels threatened by potential use of esoteric abilities, not Plagueis's own power."
- lorenzo.r.2nd: "plagueis hype is almost as bad as vitiate tbh lol"
- BreakofDawn later backs off: "I've changed my opinion on Plagueis since this post. Same goes for TPM Sidious." **This rebuttal landed.**

## Common counterarguments and rebuttals that seemed to land
- "Plagueis is near ROTS Sidious" → countered by (a) the end-of-novel power-up after Plagueis's death and (b) a decade of growth before ROTS. BreakofDawn conceded.
- Caedus's "secrets lost to the Jedi" knowledge is used to answer Plagueis's esoteric-knowledge argument.

## Scaling chains used
- Plagueis < ROTS Sidious, by a big margin, because of the post-Plagueis "power up" plus about a decade of growth (DC77).
- Caedus ≥ Plagueis on breadth of knowledge (DC77). This is opinion with no quote cited.
- Jaina amped by Luke ~ Caedus ("Jacen's parity with Luke amped Jaina", DC77). This is a feat claim with no citation in the thread.

## Conflicts and unsupported claims vs our notes
- Our `sidious-comicvine-respect.txt` has the Darth Plagueis novel quote "Sidious knew that his own powers had increased tenfold over the decades, but he couldn't be certain he had learned all of Plagueis' secrets - 'his sorcerer's ways'". This **supports** DC77's point that Sidious's worry was about Plagueis's *secrets*, not raw power. Note the quote is about Sidious's growth, not a post-death power-up specifically.
- No poster cites a Krayt feat. A debater should bring them from `krayt-legends-quotes.txt` / `legends-feats.md`. The thread's verdicts are pure opinion.

## Original-work check (added 2026-10-11)
Each quote, scan or feat cited above, with its original work. "Named in thread" means a poster gave the work. "From our notes" means the same quote is in one of our files, with the source shown there. "NOT IDENTIFIED" means neither the thread nor our notes give the work. Those are left unsourced, not guessed. Poster verdicts and opinions are not listed.
- "increased tenfold … his sorcerer's ways" (Sidious) → *Darth Plagueis* (novel), from our notes: `sidious-comicvine-respect.txt` L579-580 ("Source named in post: Darth Plagueis"). Chapter not given.
- DC77, "Jacen learned secrets that had been lost to the Jedi for centuries … hugely diverse skill set" → a poster paraphrase with no work named. NOT IDENTIFIED.
- "Jacen's parity with Luke amped Jaina" (DC77) → no work named in the thread. NOT IDENTIFIED.
